message:
test(apk): the held-point contrast made deterministic and able to tell the held check from the send check; a race in liveness [13] (keepalive-r2 e, apk-decoder-inbox C r1)

Tests only -- no product source changes (the APKs of 53e3fdb stand).

android_decoder_inbox_session_test [S3]:
- the limiter made to refuse by its MINIMUM INTERVAL (3 s, tokens plenty) instead of one token per 1.5 s: with the
  token setting 2 of 3 runs took the +1 s retry (the case never reached the held state; why the bucket let it through
  was not found -- the product limiter is unchanged by C);
- 3.5 s after the limiter change before the loss (one whole interval): a request of the pick's setup refused the loss's
  FIRST ask in 1 of 3 runs;
- also asserts that nothing reaches the ACCEPTED point after the held drop: with the held check taken out (mutant
  m_skip_held) the request went back into the limiter and was caught only at the send -- "not sent" alone passed it.
Now 5/5 on the C build; m_skip_held 2/2 red (accepted after the held drop=1), m_skip_accepted 2/2 red (sent).

android_decoder_liveness_test [13]: the released seq is read BEFORE the next real attach -- once that attach is
applied the worker lets the old window go and the seq moves legitimately; read after it, 1 run in 3 on C's build
failed (79b5c25's sink 5/5 passed, the worker just came later). 5/5 now.
